title: Fail-closed on non-loopback admin: Err not warn is correct
description: Changing check_admin_addr from Option<String> (warning) to Result<(), String> (error) is the right call. The previous allow_non_loopback escape hatch invited operators to bypass the protection without understanding the risk. Fail-closed means the daemon refuses to start in an insecure configuration rather than emitting a warning that might be swallowed by log aggregation. A contributor might propose restoring the flag for 'flexibility' — reject this: any legitimate non-loopback deployment requires a bearer token, so the error branch is unreachable for correctly-configured deployments.
